ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white dominates approximately 85% of the visible surface area, with low-intensity black concentrated at the trailing edges, median notch, and localized spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white field across both lobes. Discrete low-intensity black focal points are visible: one on the left lobe, and a cluster of three distinct spots on the right lobe. Dense black mottling concentrated at the median notch and along the continuous trailing edge border.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a sharp vertex; approximate 35-degree interior angle relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with variable pixel-amplitude (1-5px) along the entire trailing edge. Significant jaggedness and irregular 'ragged' topography observed at the distal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep from the median notch to the tips along the trailing edge; convex curvature along the visible sections of the leading edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of small, roughly circular low-contrast clusters (dark on white) at coordinates corresponding to the mid-section of both lobes, consistent with localized pigmentation or previous attachment points.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular tissue texture and possible organic growth (barnacles) at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes. Dense dark scarring/pigmentation cluster at the fluke base near the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible airborne water droplets trailing the fluke surface; organic clusters/growth visible at the distal points of the fluke lobes.
